title: Dictivo full-app network capture, 11 November 2026

tools: nettop -n -x -s 1 (every connection on the Mac, sampled once per second)
method.filter: connections owned by the process named dictivo
method.byte_counting: nettop counters are cumulative per connection: a connection open at the first sample counts last minus first; a connection opened during the window counts its last value
method.speech: three fixed English sentences played by the macOS say command through the built-in speakers and picked up by the built-in microphone
sentences: This is network test sentence one, the weather is mild today.
Sentence two, please add milk and bread to the list.
Sentence three, the meeting moves to Thursday at ten.
method.hotkey: Command+P, toggle (press once to start, once to stop)

phases.mode: Private Local, Quality profile, Large v3, Cloud Fast not locked
Private Local, Quality profile, Large v3, Cloud Fast not locked
phases.transcript: correct; saved in Dictivo history as provider local-whisper, privacy mode local-only

phases.mode: Private Local, Quality profile, Large v3, Cloud Fast not locked

not_tested: other Macs, macOS versions or app versions
discarded: An earlier run the same day (15:57 to 16:09 UTC) was discarded: Dictivo's history held no session from that window, so no Dictivo transcription took place during it.
notes: Byte counts do not show content.
The destination address is shared by several Dictivo hosts, so the address alone does not name the host.
One-second sampling can miss a very brief connection.
